description: Manage SmartOS virtual machine images through imgadm(8).

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force a given operation (where supported by imgadm(8)). Choices: false true

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: The zpool to import to or delete images from. Default: "zones"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State the object operated on should be in. imported is an alias for for present and deleted for absent. When set to vacuumed and uuid=*, it removes all unused images. Choices: "present" "absent" "deleted" "imported" "updated" "vacuumed"

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: Image UUID. Can either be a full UUID or * for all images.

examples:
- name: Import an image
  community.general.imgadm:
    uuid: '70e3ae72-96b6-11e6-9056-9737fd4d0764'
    state: imported

- name: Delete an image
  community.general.imgadm:
    uuid: '70e3ae72-96b6-11e6-9056-9737fd4d0764'
    state: deleted

- name: Update all images
  community.general.imgadm:
    uuid: '*'
    state: updated

- name: Update a single image
  community.general.imgadm:
    uuid: '70e3ae72-96b6-11e6-9056-9737fd4d0764'
    state: updated

- name: Add a source
  community.general.imgadm:
    source: 'https://datasets.project-fifo.net'
    state: present

- name: Add a Docker source
  community.general.imgadm:
    source: 'https://docker.io'
    type: docker
    state: present

- name: Remove a source
  community.general.imgadm:
    source: 'https://docker.io'
    state: absent

return_values.name: source
return_values.description: Source that is managed. Returned: When not managing an image. Sample: "https://datasets.project-fifo.net"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of the target, after execution. Returned: success Sample: "present"

return_values.name: uuid
return_values.description: UUID for an image operated on. Returned: When not managing an image source. Sample: "70e3ae72-96b6-11e6-9056-9737fd4d0764"
